collection.description: Relatives disagree about who should keep an elder's treasured weaving tools.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Relatives disagree about who should keep an elder's treasured weaving tools.

choices.label: Let the Family Take Time to Grieve

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A remembered wish resolves the dispute.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Different memories of the elder's wishes lead to further discussion.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Sharing the tools brings the relatives together.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The tools are damaged through frequent handling, prompting new rules.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Apprentices learn a traditional technique using the tools.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (relative) feels the family's memories are being made too public.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The family reaches a decision after mourning together.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The relatives agree to postpone the decision without resentment.
